create_sky_compat.configuration.title: Create Sky Compat
create_sky_compat.config.minimumGap.tool: Minimum horizontal distance from the full village footprint to island terrain, in block columns. Overlap is always rejected.
create_sky_compat.config.maximumGap.tool: Maximum distance to a sampled host island. Must be at least the minimum terrain gap.
create_sky_compat.config.minimumIslandRa: Minimum native radius of the host island. This does not change island generation.
create_sky_compat.journal.images_descrip: Show the entry icon and authored item images beside conditions and rewards.
create_sky_compat.journal.symbols_descri: Show small visual marks beside condition types. Written requirements remain visible.
create_sky_compat.journal.notifications_: Announce first objective progress and completion. Unlocking an entry does not send a notice.
create_sky_compat.journal.images.tooltip: Show the entry icon and authored item images beside conditions and rewards.
create_sky_compat.journal.symbols.toolti: Show small visual marks beside condition types. Written requirements remain visible.
Announce first objective progress and completion. Unlocking an entry does not send a notice.
create_sky_compat.configuration.local_sc: This process only; remote server settings are not shown.
create_sky_compat.configuration.startup_: Startup switches. Restart the whole game/server after editing. Missing targets remain inactive; omitted keys use their defaults. Generation-related choices are guarded by saved world identity.
create_sky_compat.configuration.village_: Local common village tuning. Captured when a local server starts; it does not configure a remote server. Existing structures remain unchanged. Available only with the village adaptation.
create_sky_compat.configuration.terrain_: Terrain tuning for Create Sky Islands. Restart after editing and use a fresh world for changed generation. Client and server files must agree; saved identity rejects incompatible changes. Available only with the preset adaptation.
create_sky_compat.configuration.bluemap_: Dedicated-server viewer settings. Requires BlueMap and Sky Archipelago, plus explicit map selection. Run bluemap reload after edits; browsers refresh within 30 seconds. Does not configure BlueMap network access or generate tiles.
create_sky_compat.configuration.journal_: Client presentation only. Edit through Journal Settings or the registered client config. Changes apply without restart; remote players keep their own preferences.
create_sky_compat.configuration.no_regis: No registered settings are active. See Adaptation status for the dependency and startup selections.
create_sky_compat.linear.carriage_obstru: Assembly positions changed. Check the assembled structure before retrying.
create_sky_compat.linear.brake_required: Engage one carriage brake before disassembling.
create_sky_compat.linear.align_before_di: Align the carriage to the rail grid before disassembling.
create_sky_compat.linear.disassembly_obs: Clear and load the destination before disassembling. Existing blocks were kept.

create_sky_compat.jade.linear.recovery: Empty-hand use recovers an aligned, braked carriage
create_sky_compat.jade.linear.sensor_hel: Read its shaft with a Redstone Converter
create_sky_compat.jade.linear.magnetic: Facing ports transfer rotation, not magnetic force

create_sky_compat.jade.linkage.remove: Sneak-use a wrench on the rod to disconnect

create_sky_compat.ponder.linear_assembly: Linear Casings form a passive guide. Match the bearing and casing orientations.
Glue the payload together above the bearing.
Right-click the bearing with an empty hand to assemble the payload.
The bearing becomes a casing. The assembled carriage can slide along matching rails.
create_sky_compat.ponder.linear_brake.te: Gravity or an external force moves the carriage. The guide supplies no driving power.
Redstone power on the moving carriage engages its brake at the current position.
Remove power to release the brake. Keep any powered drive separate from the brake circuit.
create_sky_compat.ponder.linear_recovery: Engage the brake and align the payload with the block grid before recovery.
Right-click the casing with an empty hand to recover one aligned, braked carriage.
Recovery preserves the payload. Occupied spaces or a misaligned carriage prevent it.
Recover the assembly before removing the rails you intend to reuse.
create_sky_compat.ponder.linear_magnetic: Place two Magnetic Ports facing each other across a clear gap.
Supply rotation through a rear shaft. The facing port transfers it to the receiving network.
The source supplies the connected load. Overloading it stalls the network.
Magnetic Ports transfer rotation. They do not pull a carriage like Aeronautics' Redstone Magnets.
create_sky_compat.ponder.linear_spring.t: Torsional Anchors transfer rotation through a spring connection.
Place a Spring Head in front of each anchor, then connect the two heads.
Drive one anchor from a kinetic network. The linked anchor carries its rotation and load.
This is a rotational connection, not a motor that extends a linear carriage.
create_sky_compat.ponder.linear_gyro.tex: Mount the Gyroscopic Gearbox on a simulated body to measure its angular velocity.
Its shaft signal follows rotation about the selected axis. It has no stress capacity and supplies no driving power.
A Redstone Converter reads one signal level per 8 RPM, up to 15. Use the signal in a separate control circuit.
When the body stops rotating, the sensor returns to zero. It does not hold an angle or stabilize the body.
